headline: Dolby Laboratories Reports Q4 and Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
summary: Dolby Laboratories announced its fourth-quarter and fiscal year 2026 financial results, posting total revenue of $374 million compared to $307 million a year earlier.
why: Dolby Laboratories licenses audio and imaging technologies to entertainment and consumer electronics companies, serving as an indicator of demand in media hardware.
